WITH count_sums as (
    SELECT c.concept_name as condition_name, 
           count(*) as num_rows, 
           count(distinct person_id) as num_participants
    FROM ehr_union.condition_occurrence co
    LEFT JOIN omop_vocab.concept c
      ON c.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    GROUP BY c.concept_name
),
total_rows as (
     SELECT sum(num_rows) as total_row_ct
     FROM count_sums
),
total_participants as (
    SELECT count(distinct person_id)  as total_participant_ct
    FROM ehr_union.person
)
SELECT distinct cs.condition_name,
    CASE
      WHEN num_rows <= 20 THEN '<=20'
      ELSE num_rows
    END AS num_rows,
    tr.total_row_ct,
    cs.num_rows/tr.total_row_ct as fraction_rows, 
    fraction_rows*100 as percent_rows,
    CASE
      WHEN num_participants <= 20 THEN '<=20'
      ELSE num_participants
    END AS num_participants,
    tp.total_participant_ct, 
    cs.num_participants/tp.total_participant_ct as fraction_participants,
    fraction_participants*100 as percent_participants
FROM count_sums  cs
JOIN total_rows tr
JOIN total_participants tp
ORDER BY percent_rows DESC
LIMIT 16

JOIN site s ON co.data_partner_id = s.data_partner_id

site, data_partner_id,condition_name, condition_count
FROM ranked_condition
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY site, condition_count DESC;

    FROM ehr_union.drug_exposure de
    WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (
        1502905, 1503297, 1516766, 1525215, 1550023,
        1567198, 1580747, 36213643, 36213644, 40098705
    )
    OR de.drug_concept_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id
        FROM omop_vocab.concept_ancestor ca
        WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (
            1502905, 1503297, 1516766, 1525215, 1550023,
            1567198, 1580747, 36213643, 36213644, 40098705
        )
    )
),
site_population AS (
    SELECT 
        site_id.site,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) as total_patients
    FROM ehr_union.person p
    LEFT JOIN ehr_dqp.site_id ON p.data_partner_id = site_id.data_partner_id
    GROUP BY site_id.site
)
SELECT 
    site_id.site,
    b.drug_concept_name,
    COUNT(b.drug_exposure_id) as total_exposures,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.person_id) as unique_patients_on_drug,
    sp.total_patients as site_total_patients,
    -- Per capita metrics
    ROUND(COUNT(b.drug_exposure_id) * 1.0 / sp.total_patients, 4) as exposures_per_capita,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT b.person_id) * 100.0 / sp.total_patients, 2) as pct_population_on_drug,
    -- Per patient metrics (among those on the drug)
    ROUND(COUNT(b.drug_exposure_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT b.person_id), 2) as exposures_per_patient
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN ehr_dqp.site_id ON b.data_partner_id = site_id.data_partner_id
LEFT JOIN site_population sp ON site_id.site = sp.site
GROUP BY site_id.site, b.drug_concept_name, sp.total_patients

datasets.name: vital_pct_site_summary
datasets.displayName: % Persons with 2+ Vitals by Site with Vital Counts
queryLines:
WITH person_vitals AS (
    SELECT
        data_partner_id,
        person_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT measurement_concept_id) AS vital_concept_cnt
    FROM ehr_union.measurement
    WHERE measurement_concept_id IN (
        3036277,  -- body height
        3020891,  -- body temperature
        3025315,  -- body weight
        3012888,  -- diastolic
        3027018,  -- heart rate
        40762499, -- oxygen saturation
        3004249,  -- systolic
        4245997   -- bmi
    )
    GROUP BY data_partner_id, person_id
),
persons_with_2plus AS (
    SELECT data_partner_id, person_id
    FROM person_vitals
    WHERE vital_concept_cnt >= 2
),
site_summary AS (
    SELECT
        data_partner_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_persons_with_any_vital,
        SUM(CASE WHEN vital_concept_cnt > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS persons_with_2plus_vitals
    FROM person_vitals
    GROUP BY data_partner_id
),
vital_counts AS (
    SELECT
        m.data_partner_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id = 3036277 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS body_height_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id = 3020891 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS body_temperature_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id = 3025315 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS body_weight_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id = 3012888 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diastolic_bp_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id = 3027018 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heart_rate_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id = 40762499 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oxygen_saturation_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id = 3004249 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS systolic_bp_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id = 4245997 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bmi_count
    FROM ehr_union.measurement m
    INNER JOIN persons_with_2plus p
        ON m.data_partner_id = p.data_partner_id AND m.person_id = p.person_id
    WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IN (
        3036277, 3020891, 3025315, 3012888,
        3027018, 40762499, 3004249, 4245997
    )
    GROUP BY m.data_partner_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(si.site, CAST(s.data_partner_id AS STRING)) AS site,
    s.data_partner_id,
    s.total_persons_with_any_vital,
    s.persons_with_2plus_vitals,
    ROUND(100.0 * s.persons_with_2plus_vitals / NULLIF(s.total_persons_with_any_vital, 0), 2) AS pct_persons_with_2plus_vitals,
    v.body_height_count,
    v.body_temperature_count,
    v.body_weight_count,
    v.diastolic_bp_count,
    v.heart_rate_count,
    v.oxygen_saturation_count,
    v.systolic_bp_count,
    v.bmi_count
FROM site_summary s
INNER JOIN vital_counts v ON s.data_partner_id = v.data_partner_id
LEFT JOIN ehr_dqp.site_id si ON s.data_partner_id = si.data_partner_id
ORDER BY s.data_partner_id

queryLines:

  FROM

  WHERE
    data_partner_id IN (3058, 8469, 2084)
),
lab_grouped AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    data_partner_id,
    person_id,
    CASE
      WHEN
        LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%creatinine, urine, random%'
      THEN
        'Creatinine, Urine, Random'
      WHEN
        LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%albumin, urine%'
        AND LOWER(measurement_concept_name) NOT LIKE '%creatinine%'
      THEN
        'Albumin, Urine'
      WHEN
        LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%albumin/creatinine ratio%'
        OR LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%uacr%'
      THEN
        'Albumin/Creatinine Ratio (uACR)'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%glucose%' THEN 'Glucose'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%sodium%' THEN 'Sodium'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%potassium%' THEN 'Potassium'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%chloride%' THEN 'Chloride'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%anion gap%' THEN 'Anion Gap'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%blood urea nitrogen%' THEN 'Blood Urea Nitrogen'
      WHEN
        LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%creatinine%'
        AND LOWER(measurement_concept_name) NOT LIKE '%albumin/creatinine%'
        AND LOWER(measurement_concept_name) NOT LIKE '%creatinine, urine, random%'
      THEN
        'Creatinine'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%ast/sgot%' THEN 'AST/SGOT'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%alkaline phosphatase%' THEN 'Alkaline Phosphatase'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%alt/sgpt%' THEN 'ALT/SGPT'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%bilirubin, total%' THEN 'Bilirubin, total'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%calcium%' THEN 'Calcium'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%protein, total%' THEN 'Protein, total'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%serum albumin%' THEN 'Albumin, Serum'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%globulin%' THEN 'Globulin'
      WHEN
        LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%egfr%'
        OR LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%estimated glomerular filtration rate%'
      THEN
        'eGFR'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%a/g ratio%' THEN 'A/G Ratio'
      WHEN
        LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%lipid profile%'
        OR LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%cholesterol%'
      THEN
        'Lipid / Cholesterol'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%triglyceride%' THEN 'Triglyceride'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%hdl cholesterol%' THEN 'HDL Cholesterol'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%ldl cholesterol%' THEN 'LDL Cholesterol'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%vldl%' THEN 'VLDL'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%non hdl cholesterol%' THEN 'Non-HDL Cholesterol'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%c-peptide%' THEN 'C-Peptide'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%vitamin d%' THEN 'Vitamin D'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%hemoglobin a1c%' THEN 'Hemoglobin A1C'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS lab_category
  FROM
    ehr_union.measurement
  WHERE
    data_partner_id IN (3058, 8469, 2084)
),
site_lab_counts AS (
  SELECT
    sp.data_partner_id,
    lg.lab_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sp.person_id) AS total_persons_in_site,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lg.person_id) AS persons_with_lab
  FROM
    site_persons sp
      LEFT JOIN lab_grouped lg
        ON sp.data_partner_id = lg.data_partner_id
        AND sp.person_id = lg.person_id
  WHERE
    lg.lab_category IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    sp.data_partner_id,
    lg.lab_category
)
SELECT
  slc.data_partner_id,
  s.site,
  slc.lab_category,
  slc.total_persons_in_site,
  slc.persons_with_lab,
  (slc.total_persons_in_site - slc.persons_with_lab) AS persons_without_lab
FROM
  site_lab_counts slc
    LEFT JOIN ehr_dqp.site_id s
      ON slc.data_partner_id = s.data_partner_id
ORDER BY
  slc.data_partner_id,
  slc.lab_category

        AND LOWER(measurement_concept_name) NOT LIKE '%creatinine, urine, random%'

      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%calcium%' THEN 'Calcium'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%protein, total%' THEN 'Protein, total'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%serum albumin%' THEN 'Albumin, Serum'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%globulin%' THEN 'Globulin'
      WHEN
        LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%egfr%'
        OR LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%estimated glomerular filtration rate%'
      THEN
        'eGFR'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%a/g ratio%' THEN 'A/G Ratio'
      WHEN
        LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%lipid profile%'
        OR LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%cholesterol%'
      THEN
        'Lipid / Cholesterol'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%triglyceride%' THEN 'Triglyceride'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%hdl cholesterol%' THEN 'HDL Cholesterol'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%ldl cholesterol%' THEN 'LDL Cholesterol'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%vldl%' THEN 'VLDL'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%non hdl cholesterol%' THEN 'Non-HDL Cholesterol'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%c-peptide%' THEN 'C-Peptide'
      WHEN LOWER(measurement_concept_name) LIKE '%vitamin d%' THEN 'Vitamin D'

      ELSE NULL
    END AS lab_category,

)
SELECT

  ROUND(AVG(lg.lab_count), 2) AS avg_lab_count_per_patient,

FROM

  lg.lab_category IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY

ORDER BY
